en_before: Oversized does not simply mean buying two sizes up. A drafted roomy cut considers shoulders, armholes, sleeves and body together. A larger regular size may lengthen sleeves without giving the proportions you want. Prioritize finished garment measurements. For combinations after purchase, see women’s leather-jacket outfit ideas.
